name: Lakeville Thursday Scramble
oneLiner: The Thursday night version of the Monday scramble — two-person, against the field, handicapped, with 12 weeks of regular season and two of playoffs. League Member Extra’s: (2) Hours of anytime sim time to use outside of league!
beginnerNote: The friendliest format on the schedule: you both hit, you play the better ball, and the scorecard never records which of you hit the bad one. Handicaps keep the field level.
format: 2-person scramble against the field, handicapped, 18 holes. Format may change based on player feedback.
price: $980 per team. A $50 non-refundable deposit per team holds your spot.
prizes: Prizes dependent on size of League
